title: Planet Tweaks V3.4.2 - Tweak Test Lab & Hone Permanent Preservation Release
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.4.2: (1) Tweak Test Lab Integration: Dedicated isolation lab tab with individual test cards for isolated verification of queue depths, FilterKeys 0 delay, Win32 Priority Separation, and Global Timer Resolution without modifying automated zero-delay packs. (2) Hone Optimization Permanent Preservation: All 11 active Hone tweaks permanently secured into Windows kernel and user registries. (3) Input & Shutdown Stability: Permanent ACPI power-down fix (PowerdownAfterShutdown=1) and mouse class queue overflow protection (MouseDataQueueSize=100) preventing post-reboot click drops. (4) UI Version Alignment: Clean v3.4.2 branding across all Windows chrome headers, Alt-Tab switcher, auto-updater endpoints, and Discord Rich Presence.
